info.title: Rustbox
info.description: Internal IMAP/SMTP service. Authenticated apps share access to all accounts. Webhooks sign timestamp + dot + exact JSON bytes using HMAC-SHA256 in X-Rustbox-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>.

adminSession.description: Opaque admin session obtained by exchanging any application key. HttpOnly, SameSite cookie scoped to /admin.

adminCsrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
adminCsrf.description: Session CSRF token returned by the session endpoint; required for mutations.

sync_from.description: Inclusive persisted received/internal date cutoff; omitted default resolved once at provisioning

AccountInput.description: Native accounts require backend, credential_id and target_mailbox. IMAP accounts require imap/smtp. watched_folders contains provider folder/label identifiers.

content_id.description: Content-ID without angle brackets; required for inline parts

source.description: Gmail source label to remove; other labels remain unchanged

subject.description: Required only for Google Workspace delegation

SendingLimits.description: Limits for the implemented Rustbox send path. Lower tenant, mailbox, server, or recipient limits may apply. MIME size includes all headers and transfer-encoded attachments before outer API encoding.

supported_path_max_mime_bytes.description: Microsoft: 209715200 (200 MiB total MIME); Google: 26214400; SMTP: null. Lower configured and mailbox limits apply.

max_mime_bytes.description: Effective limit: minimum of configured and supported send-path limits.

max_encoded_request_bytes.description: Microsoft: 4194304 per Graph control request, not a complete-message limit; Google: 35000000 for the whole JSON send request; SMTP: null.

max_attachment_bytes.description: Microsoft: 150000000 decoded bytes per file; lower total MIME/configured/mailbox limits also apply. Gmail/SMTP: null because attachment space depends on MIME overhead.

large_attachment_upload_supported.description: True for Microsoft Graph draft/upload sessions, false for Gmail and generic SMTP.

max_draft_mime_bytes.description: Microsoft base MIME excluding attachments: 3000000 bytes; other backends: null.

max_upload_chunk_bytes.description: Microsoft sequential attachment chunk cap: 3276800 bytes; other backends: null.

allow_duplicate_copy.description: Required with a reason for deliberate duplicate-risk retry after unknown APPEND and conclusive not_found reconciliation.

graph_phase.description: Durable Microsoft draft/upload phase; null for other backends. Preparation resumes, final submission is never automatically repeated.
